Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Seagulls Across The Water Sunset Horizon Canvas Print Wall Art, 45" x 30"
Colors: Multi
Materials: canvas
After a long day, this tranquil print will help you relax. Birds sweep through a sunset horizon with all the blues, purples and oranges you remember from vacations with friends and family. This natural scene will blend with any existing style. A contemporary print of a classic, timeless scene Hand-stretched canvas on wood. Ready to hang with hardware included. 45" x 30" Made to order
